newsitem.title: USA: Network seeks complaint vs Cablevision - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Network seeks complaint vs Cablevision - NYT.

text.p: The Classic Sports Network plans to file a complaint accusing Cablevision Systems Corp of using coercive tactics to obtain an equity stake in Classic Sports, the New York Times said Monday.

A letter Classic Sports sent to Cablevision accuses Cablevision of refusing to distribute Classic Sports Network to Cablevision subscribers because Classic Sports refused to sell an equity stake to Cablevision, the report said.

The report said Classic Sports President Stephen Greenberg is accusing Cablevision of violating federal law, which prohibits cable operators from using "coercive tactics" to obtain ownership interests.
The report said Classic Sports intends to file a complaint with the Federal Communications Commission after a required one-week waiting period.
